title: ToolsPanel second column clips off the right — host wrapper width (44px) too small for the 2-column grid (67px panel)
description:
REPRO: Open the Tools panel. After the task 1267 fix (commit d1bb50a, present at HEAD a1360a6) tools render in TWO columns again, but the SECOND (right) column is cut off at the panel's right edge — the right column clips.

ROOT CAUSE: ToolsPanel renders correctly at its spec width. The clip comes from the HOST WRAPPER in Shell.tsx, not from ToolsPanel's own grid.
- Shell.tsx:3051 wraps <ToolsPanel> in <div style={{ width: 44, minWidth: 44, flexShrink: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>. The hardcoded 44px width + overflow:hidden clips everything past x=44.
- ToolsPanel.tsx:312 panel width = PANEL_WIDTH = metrics.toolsPanelWidth = 67 (flash8Theme.ts:255), with borderRight 1px (flash8Theme.ts:77 borderThin=1) -> 66px inner. ToolsPanel.tsx:323-329 toolGrid = gridTemplateColumns repeat(2, BTN_SIZE px) where BTN_SIZE = metrics.toolCell = 22 (flash8Theme.ts:257), gap 1px, padding 0 1px, boxSizing border-box -> grid content width = 22+22+1(gap)+2(padding) = 47px, centered (panel alignItems:center + grid justifyContent:center).
- WIDTH MATH: the 47px 2-col grid fits the panel's 66px inner width fine; ToolsPanel is internally correct. But the panel is 67px while its Shell wrapper is only 44px with overflow:hidden. The centered grid spans roughly x=9.5..56.5 inside the 67px panel; the wrapper clips at x=44, cutting off the right column (~x32.5..54.5). 44px == a single-column width, which is why this was invisible until 1267 restored 2 columns.

INCOMPLETE-1267 vs SEPARATE: This is functionally an INCOMPLETE task 1267 fix. The 44px wrapper itself predates 1267 (git blame -> commit 4b4e4cf 'initial progress'), but it was harmless while the grid was effectively single-column. Task 1267 (d1bb50a) restored gridTemplateColumns repeat(2, 22px) -> 67px panel WITHOUT widening the Shell host wrapper from 44px, so the visible right-column clip surfaced with 1267. (HEAD a1360a6.)

EXPECTED: Both tool columns fully visible within the tools panel, panel ~67px per docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md (tools panel width ~67px, tool cell ~22px; lines 158-159).
ACTUAL: Right column clipped at the wrapper's right edge.

FIX DIRECTION: Widen the Shell.tsx:3051 host wrapper to fit the 2-column panel — set width/minWidth to PANEL_WIDTH (67), ideally reference metrics.toolsPanelWidth instead of the magic 44 so it tracks the spec. Keep overflow:hidden (or drop it) only after the wrapper is wide enough. ToolsPanel's own grid/padding/justify are correct (symmetric padding, justifyContent:center) — no change needed there; avoid introducing a left-bias. References task 1267 (d1bb50a).
